tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background. Pure black like the Seeker system UI; the camera sitting and the walkthrough sit straight on it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards and list rows. Tinted very slightly teal so a card separates from `canvas` without a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Bottom nav, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed states, tier chips, input fields.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1dp borders, the only separation on black: cards, the nav's top edge, the secondary button. 1.3:1 on `surface-1`, below the 3:1 control-border floor; kept exact as the theme has it (`HoldoutColors.Hairline`), so a secondary button must also carry its white label.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Top and bottom bands over the camera preview, so overlaid text stays legible.

tokens.name: drag-handle
tokens.usage: The sheet's drag handle (white at 24%).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Numbers, headlines, body. 21:1 on `canvas`, 15.9:1 on `surface-3`.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Captions under a number, supporting copy. 10:1 on `canvas`, 8.5:1 on `surface-3`.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Labels, inactive nav icons, metadata. 4.9:1 on `canvas` and `surface-1`, 4.7:1 on `surface-3`; never lighter grounds.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tide Light. The one interactive colour: links, selection, focus ring, progress, the skeleton overlay, countdowns. 15.4:1 on `canvas`, 11.6:1 on `surface-3`.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Tide. Rare emphasis on an accent surface.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: `accent` at 12%: the fill of a selected tier chip. `accent` text on it over `surface-3` holds 8.5:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Solana Green. Still standing, day complete, claim, confirmed transactions, a share that went up. 14:1 on `canvas`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Coral. Forfeit, the last-10-minutes countdown, faucet exhausted, leave and stop actions, the short-test-cohort badge. Never a harsh red. 7.1:1 on `canvas`, 5.3:1 on `surface-3`.

tokens.name: celebration
tokens.usage: Solana Purple, exact from the brand kit. Decoration only: the gradient's start and the personal-best flame. Never on the cover or as a fill elsewhere. Never text: 4.7:1 on `canvas`, 3.5:1 on `surface-3`, so it clears 3:1 for icons and marks but not 4.5:1 for text. When purple must be read, use `celebration-text`.

tokens.name: celebration-text
tokens.usage: Solana Purple lightened, same hue: the rare purple that has to be read, such as a PB label or a personal-best caption. 7.6:1 on `canvas`, 6.8:1 on `surface-1`, 6.3:1 on `surface-2`, 5.7:1 on `surface-3`. Never in the gradient; that stays `celebration`.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: The primary button: a white pill.

tokens.name: on-light
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `inverse-surface` (the primary button, the active nav pill). 21:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill. 11.5:1.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a `success` fill (the claim button after signing). 13:1.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a `warning` fill. 6.7:1.

tokens.name: gradient-start
tokens.usage: Start of the Solana gradient, 45°. Reserved for two moments only: day complete and claim success, a single ~900ms sweep.

tokens.name: gradient-end
tokens.usage: End of the Solana gradient. Same two moments, nothing else.

tokens.name: palette-sky
tokens.usage: Spare Solana palette hue for a screen that needs a second colour. One spare hue per screen at most; 5:1 on `canvas`, decoration on lighter grounds.

tokens.name: palette-charge
tokens.usage: Spare Solana palette hue. One spare hue per screen at most.

tokens.name: palette-kelp
tokens.usage: Spare Solana palette hue. Too close to `success` to sit beside it; one spare hue per screen at most.

tokens.name: palette-beach
tokens.usage: Spare Solana palette hue. One spare hue per screen at most.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: The survivor counter and the rep count: the largest thing on any screen. Tabular figures; it rolls to a new value, never cuts.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: SKR amounts, countdowns, wallet addresses. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: If nobody drops out, you get exactly your stake back.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Captions under numbers, nav labels, chips. Uppercase, applied at the call site.

spacing.note: A 4dp base grid; screens use these names and never invent their own numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The base unit: icon-to-label gaps, the bank ring's segment gap.

tokens.name: space-tight
tokens.usage: Between lines inside a card; between a number and its caption.

tokens.name: space-items
tokens.usage: Between list items and between cards.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Screen gutters, left and right.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Padding inside a card.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Tier chips and label chips.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and list rows.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, top corners only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the active nav pill: fully rounded.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary button height; roster row height.

tokens.name: size-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom nav bar height.

tokens.name: size-ring-stroke
tokens.usage: The bank ring's stroke on its `hairline` track.

tokens.name: size-border
tokens.usage: Every hairline border.
